strNameFriendly: Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module
strNameShort: Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module
strDesc:
Asterel's N1 lets Polaris take the long approach while you keep an eye on the rest of the ship. Torch flight where permitted, RCS for fallback and close control, and a stopping distance chosen by the captain. A little less time chasing the same numbers across the console.

Hull clearance and no-wake rules still apply, including below 5,000 km. Docking needs its own command and clearance, and avoidance depends on tracked contacts. Repair or Restore a worn unit for further service; dismantling leaves board residue. The N2 adds continuous following. Polaris can handle the approach. It still needs a captain who knows where the ship is going.

strNameFriendly: Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module (Damaged)
strNameShort: Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module (Damaged)
strDesc:
A Phobos' Asterel N1 Polaris Auto Nav Module with its next watch waiting on the repair bench. The maker's promise of an easier approach needs working electronics first.

Repair with two small electronic parts, then Restore the remaining wear before fitting it to work in a Polaris navigation station. Dismantling retains 0.4 kg of board residue. There may be another voyage in this board, after the maintenance.

strNameFriendly: Phobos' Asterel N2 Polaris Pursuit Module
strNameShort: Phobos' Asterel N2 Polaris Pursuit Module
strDesc:
Asterel's N2 keeps a moving appointment. Rendezvous approaches a contact and matches motion once; Follow keeps pace. Navigation and docking are included, for captains whose destination has a flight plan of its own.

Weapons require a separate N3. Avoidance uses tracked contacts, and a faster ship may still get away. Loading a save pauses pursuit; resume when the situation is checked. The N2 supplies the manoeuvres, without a promise that every chase ends at the range you wanted.

strNameFriendly: Phobos' Asterel N2 Polaris Pursuit Module (Damaged)
strNameShort: Phobos' Asterel N2 Polaris Pursuit Module (Damaged)
strDesc:
A Phobos' Asterel N2 Polaris Pursuit Module awaiting workshop attention. Following a moving contact calls for a sound board, especially when your ship has no spare room for mistakes.

Repair with two small electronic parts and Restore the remaining wear before using it in a Polaris navigation station. Dismantling retains 0.4 kg of board residue. Repair the module before asking it to keep your next appointment.

strNameFriendly: Phobos' Asterel N3 Polaris Fire Control System
strNameShort: Phobos' Asterel N3 Polaris Fire Control System
strDesc:
Asterel's N3 gives a weapons decision a measured end. Choose a target and a volley count; the system checks firing readiness and can use RCS Auto Aim to bring the ship to bear. The captain chooses how much fire to permit.

A usable sensor track and permitted, ready weapons are required. Cease Fire holds offensive fire until Return to ship controls releases it. Loading a save keeps fire on hold and never rearms the system. The N3 keeps count. The decision to open fire belongs at the captain's seat.

strNameFriendly: Phobos' Asterel N3 Polaris Fire Control System (Damaged)
strNameShort: Phobos' Asterel N3 Polaris Fire Control System (Damaged)
strDesc:
A Phobos' Asterel N3 Polaris Fire Control System in need of repair before another weapons watch. Its working duties are selected volleys and optional RCS aiming, with a usable sensor track and permitted, ready weapons still required.

Loading a save keeps offensive fire on hold. Repair the system before use. Asterel supplies the firing checks; a damaged board is no place to put your next firing decision.
